prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: precise illustrated game sprite try-on reference, transparent six-cell sprite sheet.
Primary request: Copy the exact original naked pet from the supplied atlas and fit three types of shoes onto its tiny original feet. The pet must genuinely be wearing the shoes, with its feet inside the shoes. This is NOT a drawing of shoes placed in front of the pet.
Composition: a perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid, all SIX full-body pets complete with clear transparent margin, identical scale, head size, body width, foot spacing and stance in all cells. Top row FRONT view; bottom row true BACK view with original furry back and tail and heels, never a flipped front. Column1 muted golden yellow rain boots with very SHORT ankle-height uppers, column2 cream closed-toe shell shoes with a small pale shell ornament on top of the toe, column3 sage green leaf slippers with LEAF-shaped closed toe-cover uppers and a narrow strap holding the pet foot.
Identity invariants: original head, ears or cap, original face, original torso and paws, original short leg length and exact original width between feet preserved. Tiny shoes follow the original foot footprint and do not enlarge or distort the original body's overall silhouette. Keep the original squat stance, the pet's body almost meets its paws. Do not add human legs or extra feet. The left and right shoes stay under the two original little feet.
Fitting: each paw enters the shoe naturally at its ankle. A few original fur tufts emerge over the top rim of each shoe. The shoe opening is occupied by the original leg/foot, no empty black oval hole facing the viewer. Front view shows toes and uppers; BACK view shows heel counters, back seam and ankle connection. The foot sole and shoe sole are grounded at the same baseline. Shoes have thin brown outlines, subtle fabric/rubber texture, sensible curved sole and tiny warm contact shadow between shoe and fur.
Style: match the reference's exact soft children's storybook illustration, warm brown fine hand-drawn outlines, delicate fluffy fur, subtle watercolor/pencil shading. No 3D, no flat CSS/vector, no photoreal shoes.
Background: true alpha transparency, no baked checkerboard, no scene, no floor or cast ground shadow, no labels, no frame, no text.
Avoid: huge footwear, long legs, shoes in front of paws, sideways detached shoes, empty shoe openings toward viewer, horizontal loose pair accessory, sandals shaped like little boats in front of foot, headwear, hair, shirts, bags, held objects, changed facial expression.
Subject locked to: cream plush lop-eared rabbit, exactly the upper LEFT front variant and lower LEFT back variant of reference, one upright ear and one floppy ear. Use ONLY that same variant six times. Leave all clothing off, ONLY the appropriate pair of shoes is added.
